story: At Gary's house on Thursday just after noon, Gary is cheerfully showing off his golf cart, with the bracket mounted and the lights strung but not yet switched on until the review form clears. Donna has arrived with a determined pitch: a Saturday dinner at six, pie included, and a doubles match at eight the next morning with a spare paddle waiting for Gary. Out on Magnolia Loop, Hal is dutifully counting the donna flamingos against the three-ornament limit while Rosa, equally determined, asks him for two folding chairs and heads off to corner Gary.
events: Hal (donna flamingo flock): Count the flamingos visible from the street against the three-ornament limit

gary.thought_process: Donna just walked in while I've got the speaker bracket mounted and everything sitting unpowered, waiting on Architectural Review approval. I filed the form and I'm keeping the wiring dead until it clears, so I've got nothing to hide. Best thing is to greet her, show her the progress, and be upfront that nothing gets powered until the approval comes through. She's been in my corner about the paperwork, so she'll appreciate that.

parameters.content: Well, look who's here! Come see the cart, Donna. Bracket's mounted, lights are strung, and not a single wire's live until that review form clears, so I'm staying legal.

donna.thought_process: I've just arrived at Gary's House and he's right here, which is exactly what I wanted. Rosa confirmed he's still on her Saturday list, and I told myself I'd pin him down about Saturday at six. My earlier pickleball invite got a reply from him only about the speaker, so I shouldn't repeat the coffee offer. Better to give him the dinner news and tie it to Saturday at eight, since he'll be seeing me at the courts anyway and I need him to commit as my doubles partner before the ladder closes.

parameters.content: Gary, there you are! Rosa says you're still on for Saturday at six, so pie, dinner, the works. And you're my doubles partner at eight that morning, no more dodging. I've got a spare paddle with your name on it.

hal.thought_process: Rosa's right here and I already told her I'd bring pie and be on time. She hasn't answered my question about hauling anything over, but I shouldn't repeat myself. My real goal is the Architectural Review matter. The flamingo flock is in this zone, and Donna agreed to trim to three. A quick count is just due diligence before deciding whether any notice is even needed. Check the ornaments, then see about Gary's paperwork.

parameters.content: Count the flamingos visible from the street against the three-ornament limit

rosa.thought_process: Hal already confirmed Saturday at six and offered a pie, and Donna is covered with dessert. The only guest I haven't pinned down is Gary, and Donna just headed to his house, which is one street stop away. Hal asked if I need anything hauled, so I should answer him briefly and not repeat the invite. A short reply gets me moving: I'll take him up on folding chairs, then go find Gary myself.

parameters.content: Pie and punctuality, Hal, you're a gift. If you've got two spare folding chairs for Saturday, that's all I need hauled. Now I'm going to run Gary to ground.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
